page.layout: One page with a single table, no margins. Running head "ANNORVM." across the top, with the column header line "Indiction. Anni Iul. Lit.dom. Nabon. Feriæ. ... Christi." below it. The table has three blocks separated by horizontal rules: the first has three rows, the second fifteen, the third fourteen. Signature "Ii iiij" at the foot.

main_text.l: Indiction. | Anni Iul. | Lit.dom. | Nabon. | Feriæ. | Christi.

page.notes: The first column's numerals 13–15 are followed by an asterisk-like mark, not transcribed. Dashed entries in the Feriæ column are printed as "—". The "b" after 1439 is an italic reference mark, kept as b. The Christi. entry "1421" is printed with an odd initial stroke, read as 1421 [?]. The "—31 Aug" entry lacks its final stop as printed.
